headline: Victorian Caravan Maker Essential Caravans Enters Voluntary Administration
summary: Australian caravan manufacturer Essential Caravans entered voluntary administration, joining a series of industry collapses amid ongoing financial pressures.
why: Discretionary manufacturing sectors are sensitive to rising borrowing costs, supply chain pressures, and cooling consumer spending.

impacts.name: Australian Consumer Manufacturing
impacts.why: Persistent macroeconomic pressures increase insolvency risks for smaller consumer goods manufacturers.
